fee_notes: Standard fee $55,000. Discount to $50,000 for 2nd and subsequent franchises purchased simultaneously. Additional 10% discount available for veterans, firefighters, and police officers. Fiscal 2025 collections ranged $49,500-$55,000.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee ('Initial Franchise Fee') of $55,000 when you sign the Franchise Agreement... We will discount your Initial Franchise Fee to $50,000 for the second and each subsequent Assisting Hands Franchise... During our most recent fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, we collected Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $49,500 to $55,000.
